summary: Built four mostly-independent primitives and wired their cards: Cultist Infiltrator (Equip cross-controller exception, Straighten-Phase -1C tick via CreateToken, Overlay no-transfer exclusion), Unimpeachable Name (broad out-of-play before-any-action-resolves Reaction, GainHonor loss reduction, Battle ability), Fields of Mercy (per-Terrain destroyed-Personality counter gating DestroyUnits' Personality component; Battle half needed zero new code, reused the existing generic Terrain-play branch), Yasuki Tsujiken (persistent watched-Holding marks, cleared when he leaves play, plus his Open half). All four cards' printed text re-verified against their own scans (Cultist Infiltrator's scraped catalogue text was wrong; corrected via TEXT_OVERRIDE). Crosses into src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/ only to copy the four cards' own generated art via the existing packaging pipeline (build_definition_fields), the same established cross-lane pattern every prior content wave already uses -- no other UI-lane file touched.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: 177/177 core, 52/52 published (pinned count bumped 317->321), 9/9 deck-format, 10/10 deck-workshop all passed. Manually replicated every step of bash tools/check.sh --skip-client (its own env.sh sourcing exits silently under Git Bash on this Windows worktree, a pre-existing environment quirk unrelated to this change -- verified dotnet --version matches the pinned SDK and ran each check individually): python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/collaboration (43 passed), tools/content (130 passed); dotnet build+run for L5R.Core.Tests, L5R.AI.Tests (14/14, including 10 full simulated matches across 5 seeds with the full published card pool), L5R.Server.Tests (5/5), L5R.Client.Transport.Tests (4/4) all passed. docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx regenerated (321 wired) after removing the four now-stale BLOCKERS entries.
remaining: None for the rules-side primitives; ready for review. Explicitly out of scope, flagged for Alfredo/the UI lane in the decision doc: Yasuki Tsujiken's own printed 'visual aid' signifier on a watched Holding, plus the small CardView projection (TsujikenMarks) it would need first.
